description: Takes over from Dependabot with the same behaviour: one grouped pull request per manager per week (on Mondays; the hosted app runs a repository at a time of its own choosing), and every update merges itself once all checks are green, majors included. A pull request labelled no-automerge is held. See https://github.com/sapn95/.github/blob/main/CI.md.

packageRules.description: The workflows' actions, in one pull request.
Only the actions and reusable workflows, as with Dependabot: not runs-on, container or service images, nor the values given to an action (node-version in the CI matrix stays as written).
npm, in one pull request. The ranges in package.json move with each update, as Dependabot's did.
engines.node says which Node the code supports, not which one is newest.
The Dockerfile's base images, in one pull request.
Odd Node majors never become LTS and are end of life within months of release; the image stays on the even, LTS line.
